criteria.title: Inclusive Representation
criteria.text: The [application](glossary:application) provides user options for a customizable [avatar](glossary:avatar). A wide variety of identities is offered. This includes options for avatar height, body shape, skin color, hair, prosthetic limbs, assistive devices such as hearing aids, and so on.

criteria.title: Captions: live content
criteria.text: The [application](glossary:application) provides [captions](glossary:captions) for [live](glossary:live) content, including user-generated speech in a multi-person application.

criteria.title: Caption formatting: size
criteria.text: The [application](glossary:application) provides text with a minimum cap height of 0.7 [degrees](glossary:degree-of-visual-angle). This is a common baseline for readable [captions](glossary:captions) in XR, but the ideal size depends on distance, field of view, and the [headset](glossary:head-mounted-display).

criteria.title: Caption formatting: contrast
criteria.text: The [application](glossary:application) provides [captions](glossary:captions) with a minimum [contrast ratio](glossary:contrast-ratio) of 4.5:1 in typical viewing conditions. A solid color background is recommended to ensure consistent contrast across different environments.

criteria.title: Audio Descriptions: triggered
criteria.text: Triggered - The [application](glossary:application) offers [audio descriptions](glossary:audio-description) for important visual events (e.g. characters entering or leaving, major environmental changes, proximity to interactables).

criteria.title: Points of Interest: role
criteria.text: Spatial elements relevant to navigation have a [programmatically-determined](glossary:programmatically-determined) role and functional meaning. Relevant elements may include routes, navigation nodes, decision points, obstacles, landmarks, destinations, points of interest, risk zones and system reliability states.

criteria.title: Target Size
criteria.text: The [application](glossary:application) contains a minimum size of hit [targets](glossary:target) as 48 x 48 pixels, or approximately 3° FOV.
criteria.flag: Open question: 48 CSS pixels is about 1 degree, not 3. The group needs to decide which size was meant. See the glossary entries for [CSS pixel](glossary:css-pixel) and [degree of visual angle](glossary:degree-of-visual-angle).
